The '''Lateral Quad 227 Laser Battery''' was a shipboard emplacement weapon produced by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. The weapon was part of the complement on board the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperator II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']].
